$schema_comment: Hooks that automate verification. The harness runs them, not the agent, so they cannot be skipped. Guards are written so they stay silent until the toolchain exists (feature 1).

hooks.command: [ -f backend/pyproject.toml ] && command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 && (cd backend && uv run pytest -q -m 'not aws' 2>&1 | tail -3) || true
hooks.description: After editing or writing files, run the default-tier tests and show a short summary.

hooks.command: ./init.sh > .harness-init.log 2>&1 && echo '[harness] init.sh OK' || (echo '[harness] init.sh FAILED — check .harness-init.log before closing' && tail -25 .harness-init.log)
hooks.description: Before closing the session, force a full verification.
